languageData.SoftResinTendrilTile.label: soft resin tendril tile
languageData.SoftResinTendrilTile.description: Tiles made of soft resin, shaped into tendrils. They are alive, so they are quicker to build, and work to keep the surface clean on their own. The resins softness makes them them significantly easier to construct. Note that walking over this tile in bare feet might tickle a bit.
languageData.HardResinTendrilTile.label: hard resin tendril tile
languageData.HardResinTendrilTile.description: Tiles made of hard resin, shaped into tendrils. They are alive, so they are quicker to build, and work to keep the surface clean on their own. The resins light crystalline structure grants them an especially refined appearance. Note that walking over this tile in bare feet might tickle a bit.
